notes.title: 2Volt Recharged
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone !
 
At beginning of 2020 we were wondering, what if Volt game is less about precision and timing and more about relaxing/forgiving gameplay.
That's how we decide to give the Volt a second chance.
At the moment there is an early version 0.1 going around internet - not sure if we can link it here, so it's better if you just check our twitter and it will take you there :)

Let us know in comments if you want to see it here on Steam - with mouse/keyboard and joypad support or .. not :)

notes.title: Hard mode ON
notes.notes:
This update brings back the initial game's difficulty which is now called [b]HARD[/b] mode.
Additionally to [b]SPACE BAR[/b] you can also use [b]LEFT SHIFT[/b] to disconnect the "newest" blue beam. We hope some of you will find it useful :)

Unfortunately this update is not available for Mac users just yet, as we have some technical issues with preparing the build.

notes.title: A new way to disconnect.
notes.notes:
With this update you can now disconnect the beam simply by pressing the space bar.

Other improvements and changes:
- the way you cut the beam using a mouse button is now more intuitive.
- difficulty and gameplay improvements.

Let us know what you think.

notes.title: Battery recharged v 1.0.5
notes.notes:
Finally, the first big update is here.

What you will find in this version:

- gameplay improvements/changes on many levels (it's a bit easier now)
- jumping (pushing) will not drain energy anymore
- gfx improvements in Zone 1

What we are planning to update next:
- remaining Zones (2-4) gfx enhancements
- add achievements
- add controller support

That's it fo.. r ... n ......

LOW BATTERY ...

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Volt, 20% off!
notes.notes:
Volt is Now Available on Steam and is 20% off!*
You were on the way to a recycling process when fortunately for you - and unfortunately for the environment - you accidentally ran off.

Now your goal is to escape from the facility, which is an extremely difficult task due to the fact that you are a battery without legs. Equipped with a limited number of electric beams, you can connect to walls, move or destroy objects, turn switches, and charge generators.

You also have the ability to jump or push off the walls - the rest is up to physics and gravity.
*Offer ends April 21 at 10AM Pacific Time
